findings.observation: Positions, allocation, portfolio risk, and investment control are one task domain but appeared in different top-level navigation groups.
findings.decision: Expose one active Portfolio workflow destination and a contextual workspace navigation shared by the four pages.
findings.expectedGain: Fewer competing top-level choices, clearer information scent, and faster movement between related portfolio tasks.

findings.observation: Legacy portfolio, risk KPI, AI insight, and setup routes overlap newer surfaces.
findings.decision: Preserve the routes in this patch because external bookmarks and operational workflows may still depend on them; remove them only after usage telemetry and redirect tests exist.
findings.expectedGain: No breaking change while the primary navigation stops advertising redundant surfaces.

findings.observation: The header and browser metadata used text-only branding and the global font varied by operating system.
findings.decision: Use the supplied logo in the global header and metadata, and self-host Inter through the package bundle.
findings.expectedGain: Consistent identity and typography without a runtime font-network dependency.

executedPlan: Add the supplied logo under public/brand and reference it through next/image.
Bundle Inter locally and make it the global interface typeface.
Create a reusable portfolio workspace navigation component.
Mount the workspace navigation in positions, allocation, risk, and governance, including loading and error states.
Remove duplicate portfolio workspace destinations from the More menu and keep the primary Portfolio item active across the workspace.
Preserve legacy URLs, APIs, account scoping, admin visibility, and page-specific data flows.

evaluation.reason: The plan consolidates navigation without merging data models or page implementations, so it produces a measurable UX gain with a small regression surface.
edgeCases: Mobile navigation must remain horizontally scrollable.
Loading and failure states must retain workspace navigation.
The Portfolio primary item must remain active on all four workspace routes.
Admin-only destinations must stay filtered for non-admin accounts.
Legacy deep links must continue to resolve.
The font must be bundled locally so CI and production do not depend on Google Fonts availability.
deferred: Deleting legacy pages before production usage data is available
